source.title: WoWtility Retail changelog v0.8.2 (creation chat events) and v0.9.7 (live bag-item level API)
source.author: JoeW980

quote: Items produced from disenchanting, milling, prospecting, and crafting also now pop up
notes: NEW source provenance/control-surface gap, NOT a measured cast cohort. WoWtility original 0.8.2 changelog, dated 2026-04-27 in the version history, states its previous loot UI ignored 'You create:' chat messages for disenchant/mill/prospect/craft products; it repaired display, not Loot Liquidator capture, and provides no casts/material histogram. Its 2026-10-14 v0.9.7 Retail 12.1.5 notes explicitly change BAG-ITEM iLvl lookups to C_Item.GetDetailedItemLevelInfo. This is proof an at-bag item-level lookup surface exists (not evidence that 272246 was disenchanting at 305), and shows a possible collector undercount if relying solely on a single loot-output channel. It does NOT establish that any particular collector missed outputs. Request via Master a player-authorized instrumented cohort pairing actual before-cast itemLink, bonus and queried ilvl with successful processing event ID, 'You create'/loot channels deduped, ranked output IDs/units, explicit per-material zeros, skill/spec, and refunds. Prior original Cardinalai/Honeybone/MikiMM/ArtisanLogbook records are deliberately NOT copied; the public page has no raw player data, so numeric fields remain unknown/null and no P(hit)/EV/zero outcomes are derived.
lookingFor: NEW Retail 12.1.5 original complete per-operation outputs for 272246 disenchant and 237362/237359/237365 prospect plus 236761 10-herb mill, checking output-channel completeness and pre-cast itemLink+actual ilvl identification
